name: Cube Ice (Cubes)
description: Solid, diamond-clear gourmet ice cubes with ultra slow melt rate. Perfect for cafés, iced coffee, mixology, restaurants, and cold beverages.
longDescription: Produced through our state-of-the-art 5-Stage Reverse Osmosis purification journey. Each cube is meticulously frozen to displace dissolved gases and impurities, yielding high density crystal clarity that chills beverages without rapid dilution.
bestFor: Iced coffee, cocktails, soft drinks, luxury dining & parties
packaging: Hygienic sealed tear-resistant food-grade Yealo polybag

name: Tube Ice (Tubes)
description: Cylindrical food-grade tube ice with a hollow core for rapid chilling and refreshing drink contact. Ideal for milk teas, fruit shakes, coolers, and high-volume stores.
longDescription: Manufactured using our advanced tubular freezing system and 5-stage reverse osmosis water. The hollow core allows drinks to flow through for fast temperature drop while maintaining clean, crisp taste and resisting clumping.
bestFor: Milk teas, smoothies, convenience stores, coolers, caterings
packaging: Hygienic sealed heavy-gauge food-grade Yealo polybag
